description: Search manufacturers and exporters across Latin America listed on Paisán, by what they make. Returns up to 20 suppliers per page with category, city, country, a short summary and a profile link. Every supplier is named. No contact details are included. To contact a supplier, send the buyer to its profileUrl on paisan.net (free to search). Software agents can buy one supplier's contact record through Paisán's paid agent API (/api/agent/v1/suppliers/{id}, see https://paisan.net/openapi.json).

category.description: Optional. Supplier category exactly as Paisán names it, e.g. "Textiles".

country.description: Optional. Country name in English, e.g. "Mexico", "Brazil", "Colombia".

query.description: What the buyer is looking for, in English, Spanish or Portuguese, e.g. "cotton denim fabric".

name: search_suppliers
title: Search Latin American suppliers
